cards.name: Cosmic Rebirth
cards.oracle_text:
Choose target permanent card in your graveyard. If it has mana value 3 or less, you may put it onto the battlefield. If you don’t put it onto the battlefield, put it into your hand.
You gain 3 life.
cards.flavor_text:
“When all the stories find their ends, a new one shall begin.”
—The Endsaga

cards.name: Lava Surge
cards.oracle_text: Lava Surge deals 3 damage to any target. If that target is a creature, it deals 4 damage instead.
cards.flavor_text: "Fire and fury will cleanse Mirrodin of Phyrexian taint—and leave nothing but ash behind."

cards.name: Awakening of Shadows
cards.oracle_text: Return target creature card from your graveyard to your hand. You lose 3 life.
cards.flavor_text:
"In the whispers of the ancients, I found the strength to call forth what was lost."
—Ertai, chronicle-scarred

cards.name: Recumbent Bliss
cards.oracle_text:
Enchant creature
Enchanted creature can’t attack or block.
At the beginning of your upkeep, you may gain 1 life.
cards.flavor_text: Kithkin somnomancers enjoy the peaceful dreams wafting from their victims.

cards.name: Glimmering Vineyard
cards.oracle_text:
This land enters tapped.
{T}: Add {G} or {W}.
cards.flavor_text:
Whispers of long-lost rituals unfurl among the vines, drawing in those brave enough to face their past.
—Tasha, the witch queen

cards.name: Duskrider Falcon
cards.oracle_text: Flying, protection from black
cards.flavor_text:
“Seaborne ships have their dolphins to dance in their wakes; I have my duskriders.”
—Sisay, journal

cards.name: Wings of Ascendancy
cards.oracle_text: Whenever a creature you control with flying attacks, you may gain 1 life.
cards.flavor_text:
"With every beat of their wings, they lift our spirits alongside their own."
—Elara, Skywarden

cards.name: Break Down the Door
cards.oracle_text:
Choose one —
• Exile target artifact.
• Exile target enchantment.
• Manifest dread. (Look at the top two cards of your library. Put one onto the battlefield face down as a 2/2 creature and the other into your graveyard. Turn it face up any time for its mana cost if it’s a creature card.)

cards.name: Stormblade Berserker
cards.oracle_text:
Haste
Whenever Stormblade Berserker attacks, it deals 1 damage to target player or planeswalker.
cards.flavor_text:
His rage echoed through the tempest, a harbinger of the chaos that followed.
—Krel, Stormfront Marauder

cards.name: Challenger Troll
cards.oracle_text: Each creature you control with power 4 or greater can’t be blocked by more than one creature.
cards.flavor_text: For most, war is a calamity. For some, an opportunity. And for the very few, a pleasure.

cards.name: Ichormoon Gauntlet
cards.oracle_text:
Planeswalkers you control have "0: Proliferate" and "–12: Take an extra turn after this one."
Whenever you cast a noncreature spell, choose a counter on target permanent. Put an additional counter of that kind on that permanent.

cards.name: Insectile Ambition
cards.oracle_text:
At the beginning of your upkeep, create a 1/1 colorless Insect artifact creature token with flying.
Whenever you sacrifice an artifact, Insectile Ambition deals 1 damage to any target.

cards.name: Grim Spawn
cards.oracle_text: {B/G}: Regenerate Grim Spawn.
cards.flavor_text: Born of twilight's dread, it feasts on fear and shadows alike.

cards.name: Phantom Beast
cards.oracle_text: When Phantom Beast becomes the target of a spell or ability, sacrifice it.
cards.flavor_text: As insubstantial as fear, and as dangerous.

cards.name: Frosthowl Warg
cards.oracle_text:
Trample
Whenever Frosthowl Warg deals combat damage to a player, you may sacrifice another creature. If you do, return target creature card from your graveyard to your hand.

cards.name: Sylvan Steed
cards.oracle_text:
Sylvan Steed has trample. (This creature can deal excess combat damage to the player or planeswalker it's attacking.)
Whenever Sylvan Steed attacks, you may pay {1}. If you do, Sylvan Steed gains first strike until end of turn.

cards.name: Gristle Grinner
cards.oracle_text: Whenever a creature is put into a graveyard from play, Gristle Grinner gets +2/+2 until end of turn.
cards.flavor_text:
"There it was, clawing the ice as it chittered and clicked its teeth. We fled in horror before it unearthed its grisly meal."
—Aevar Borg, northern guide, journal entry

cards.name: Basalt Monolith
cards.oracle_text:
This artifact doesn't untap during your untap step.
{T}: Add {C}{C}{C}.
{3}: Untap this artifact.

cards.name: Obliterating Bolt
cards.oracle_text: Obliterating Bolt deals 4 damage to target creature or planeswalker. If that creature or planeswalker would die this turn, exile it instead.
cards.flavor_text: In desperation, Pero called on his memory of a lightning storm that nearly killed his family. When he opened his eyes, only smoke and dust remained.

cards.name: Chaotic Convergence
cards.oracle_text:
Chaotic Convergence deals 6 damage divided as you choose among any number of targets.
Create a 3/1 red Elemental creature token with haste. Exile that token at the beginning of the next end step.
